fields.label: Line Description

fields.options:
Available in formulas and conditions

  • params.CODE - any Building Parameter code. Numeric answers come through as numbers, everything else as text. A parameter the client left blank is 0 (numeric) or "" (text), never missing.
  • flt, round, min, max, abs

Examples

  • Roof area with 5% lap: params.BUILDING_LENGTH * params.BUILDING_WIDTH * 1.05
  • Crane beam: params.CRANE_SPAN * params.NO_OF_CRANES * 0.22
  • Only when a crane is asked for - Condition: params.CRANE_REQD == "Yes"
  • Ventilators: params.TURBO_VENT_QTY
